name: Warp
tagline: Terminal with a built-in coding agent, a CLI, and cloud agents.
description: Warp is a terminal application with a built-in coding agent that runs commands, edits files, and reviews diffs. The same agent is available through the Warp Agent CLI and as cloud agents on Warp's Automation Platform.

pricing.notes: Free tier; Build $20/mo, Max $200/mo, Business $50/user/mo, and Enterprise.
